statement: Published results reported by others. Wet-lab entries are PHYSICAL (reported by others); VNX-DNA has not synthesised, stored or sequenced DNA. Values are transcribed with their source locator; null means not verified. Comparability with VNX-DNA is computed per metric by classify.py, never edited by hand.

source.locator: numbers via Erlich 2017 bioRxiv Table 1, Antkowiak 2020 Table 1, Organick 2018 Fig 1d

records.limitations: no error correction; very high coverage; secondary numbers only

records.system: Goldman et al. rotating ternary Huffman code with 4x overlapping redundancy

source.locator: numbers via Erlich 2017 supplement and Table 1, Antkowiak 2020 Table 1, Organick 2018 Fig 1d

workload.bytes: 757,051 (Erlich 2017 supplement); sources disagree: 739 kB (press), 0.63 MB (Organick 2018), 0.75 MB (Antkowiak 2020)

records.encoding_method: ternary Huffman code, base-3 rotating code
records.limitations: sources disagree on size and density; Gimpel 2026 reports it could not decode the low-fidelity in silico scenario

records.system: Grass et al. GF(47) Reed-Solomon, DNA encapsulated in silica

source.locator: numbers via Erlich 2017 supplement and Table 1, Antkowiak 2020 Table 1, Organick 2018 Fig 1d

records.encoding_method: GF(47): two bytes to nine nt (Erlich 2017 supplement)

density.locator: Antkowiak 2020 Table 1 (Organick 2018 Fig 1d gives 1.16 excl. primers)

records.conditions: silica encapsulation with accelerated ageing (lifetime extrapolations deliberately not recorded)
records.limitations: code does not handle indels (DNA-Aeon 2023); high coverage; secondary numbers only

records.system: Bornholt et al. DNA-based archival storage system

source.locator: abstract; numbers via Erlich 2017 Table 1 and Organick 2018 Fig 1d

workload.bytes: 151 kB total, 42 kB random-access subset (abstract-level, unverified)

records.limitations: full text not read; verify every field before use

records.organisation: Columbia University / New York Genome Center

source.locator: bioRxiv preprint text (posted 2016-12-04); the Science text may differ in detail

records.encoding_method: Luby-transform fountain code with droplet screening (GC 45-55 %, homopolymer <= 3)
records.codes: inner Reed-Solomon per droplet, outer fountain
records.decoding_method: message-passing LT decoding; droplets failing RS rejected
records.error_model_platform: Twist Bioscience synthesis; Illumina MiSeq 150 PE, 32 million reads
records.coverage: down-sampled to 750,000 reads with 1.3 % oligo dropout; 20 of 20 random down-samples recovered
records.recovery_capability: full recovery with zero errors; recovered after observing 69,870 of 72,000 oligos
records.software_time: encoding 2.5 min, decoding about 9 min (Python, single laptop CPU) per the preprint
records.hardware: single CPU of a standard laptop (model not stated)
records.limitations: Gimpel 2026 reports it could not decode the low-fidelity in silico scenario

records.system: Organick et al. random access in large-scale DNA data storage
records.encoding_method: randomised payload; PCR primer library for random access
records.codes: Reed-Solomon outer + inner code; 15 % logical redundancy
records.decoding_method: clustering, trace reconstruction / consensus, inner then outer decode
records.error_model_platform: Twist Bioscience synthesis; Illumina NextSeq; Oxford Nanopore stress test
records.recovery_capability: all 35 files recovered without bit errors
records.limitations: decode software runtime not reported in the text read

records.system: Takahashi et al. automated end-to-end DNA storage device
records.codes: outer (31, 26) Hamming code over a four-symbol alphabet with a checksum base
records.recovery_capability: 1 of 30 extractable payloads decoded perfectly (demonstration scale)
records.hardware: automated device with custom synthesizer and MinION

records.system: Antkowiak et al. photolithographic synthesis with read reconstruction
records.organisation: ETH Zurich / TUM / University of Vienna
records.codes: outer RS over 14-bit symbols (10,977 of 16,383 sequences data); inner RS with 6-bit symbols, 2 parity symbols
records.decoding_method: read reconstruction, then inner and outer decode
records.error_model_platform: maskless light-directed array synthesis (> 5 % error regime); Illumina NextSeq, 30 million reads
records.redundancy: about 60 % of nucleotides for error-correction redundancy
records.recovery_capability: perfect recovery despite > 5 % synthesis error levels

records.system: HEDGES (hash encoded, decoded by greedy exhaustive search)
records.encoding_method: hash-based convolutional-style code with sequence constraints
records.codes: HEDGES inner + RS(255,223) outer across strands
records.decoding_method: greedy heap search (A*-like) with a heap limit
records.error_model_platform: Twist synthesis; Illumina MiSeq 2x300; in silico random-error simulation
records.coverage: mean depth about 50 in the wet-lab test

density.locator: abstract: rate 0.6 (1.2 bits/nt) for about 1 % errors; 0.5 (1 bit/nt) for about 3 %

records.recovery_capability: abstract: corrects up to about 10 % nucleotide errors at low code rate (in silico)
records.limitations: Gimpel 2026 reports decoding hit its 1-hour limit at high error rates

workload.bytes: test files of 4.8 KB, 29.9 KB and 47.1 KB

records.codes: inner arithmetic-style code with 8-bit CRC per interval + outer Raptor fountain (NOREC4DNA)
records.error_model_platform: MESA simulator (in silico) and in vitro tests
records.recovery_capability: 100 % success up to BER 0.07 (substitutions) and 0.065 (mixed indels) in silico
records.limitations: runtime and memory grow with stack size

records.system: Benchmark of six codecs (DNA-Aeon, DNA Fountain, DNA-RS, Goldman, HEDGES, Yin-Yang)
records.decoding_method: per codec; clustering with naive, CD-HIT and LSH methods
records.error_model_platform: in silico fixed composition 53 % substitutions, 45 % deletions, 2 % insertions; DT4DDS workflow simulation; in vitro verification
records.redundancy: logical x physical redundancy tracked per scenario
records.recovery_capability: codecs tolerate up to 14 % errors and 65 % sequence loss in isolation (best cases)
records.software_time: decoding constrained to 1 hour, 8 GB, 1 CPU core
records.conditions: 95 % decode-probability threshold by logistic regression over 30 trials per point
records.limitations: a published protocol, not a codec; states that code rate alone is not a valid cross-study comparison

records.system: Modified-R10 Raptor outer code with single-edit reconstruction inner code
records.codes: outer modified-R10 Raptor; inner single-edit reconstruction code

density.bits_per_nt: 1.731 and 1.815 as stated by the preprint; primer accounting not verified
